summary: Frontend-only e2e testing of Phase-2 admin Bank Transactions features: Parser Test tab (default sample + unparseable + Send-to-Inbox), M365 Queue tab (Needs Parsing Review resolve + discard), Reconciliation tab (summary tiles, matched→unmatch→match, ignore, finance-w/o-bank list, auto-match), Import Statement PDF path. All 7 review-request scenarios PASSED.

issues: Recurring Recharts warning 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' (pre-existing, non-blocking, flagged in iteration_7 & 8)

critical_code_review_comments: ParserTestTab.send() and QueueTab.discard() both use window.confirm — must be handled with page.once('dialog', d.accept()) in playwright. Same UX inconsistency called out in iteration_8; consider a shadcn AlertDialog for testable modal confirmations.

StatementImportTab: after import the frontend renders <statement-result> only after backend AI classification returns (took >6s for 2 PDF rows). Consider optimistic setResult from the response before awaiting classification, or a spinner during doImport, so users get immediate feedback.

ParserTestTab.pt-send toast on duplicate says 'Sent to inbox — status duplicate' — this is actually a NOOP (idempotency), which is technically correct but the wording 'Sent' can mislead. Consider distinguishing 'Sent' vs 'Duplicate (already in inbox)'.

QueueTab: filter buttons show a fixed set incl. 'discarded' status but there's no filter chip for it — resolved items go to 'pending' but discarded ones become invisible in UI. Consider adding a discarded chip or a 'show discarded' toggle.
ReconciliationTab: recon-auto-btn success path calls toast.info AND toast.success back-to-back (auto() does toast.info inside act(), then act's success message). Two toasts fire — slight noise.
seed_data_creation: Via backend POST /api/bank-transactions/queue (X-Ingest-Key from backend/.env): seeded 2 unparseable messages tagged QAUI2-seed1/seed2. Via UI: (a) pt-send ingested the default ICICI MICROSOFT SUBSCRIPTION alert (duplicate on retry - idempotent). (b) queue-resolve created a pending bank txn narration 'QAUI2 MANUAL' amount 250 bank 'QA Bank'. (c) queue-discard removed one QAUI2 failed row. (d) StatementImport PDF /tmp/qaui2_statement.pdf ingested 2 ICICI PDF rows (UPI/QAUI2 TEST MERCHANT 1,234 debit + NEFT CR QAUI2 CLIENT 5,000 credit). (e) One matched approved bank txn was unmatched then re-ignored via Reconciliation (ignored count 0→1).

Confirm dialogs (pt-send, queue-discard) require page.once('dialog', lambda d: asyncio.create_task(d.accept())) — the previous asyncio.create_task pattern works with playwright async.

rca of the issue: N/A — all Phase-2 scenarios passed on first run. One initial false-negative on S6 was due to a 6s wait being shorter than the backend AI-classification latency; the import actually succeeded (confirmed on retry showing '2 already in inbox').
